doc:
Scalar-pressure Euler on a time set `I` in the original theorem's smooth
Sobolev class. The velocity and its strong time derivative have continuous L²
spatial jets of every order. The Euler equation uses this derivative witness.

As in `IsSmoothScalarEuler`, the time law and scalar-pressure equation are
required at interior times. There is no endpoint derivative condition. We use
`Ico 0 T` for a maximal lifespan and `Icc 0 T` for a closed interval.

fields.name: div_free
fields.type: ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ∀ t ∈ I, divergence (fun x => v x t) x = 0

fields.name: initial_condition
fields.type: ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), v x 0 = u₀ x

fields.name: pressure_differentiable
fields.type: ∀ t ∈ interior I, Differentiable ℝ fun x => p x t

fields.name: euler
fields.type:
∃ w,
  SobolevSmoothOn I w ∧
    (∀ t ∈ interior I, HasDerivAt (fun s => toL2 fun x => v x s) (toL2 fun x => w x t) t) ∧
      ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
        ∀ t ∈ interior I,
          w x t + (fderiv ℝ (fun x => v x t) x) (v x t) = -gradient (fun x => p x t) x
